title: Chased away again in the mall
content: I dreamt last night I was in the mall, and I had my phone on me. I saw the neon smoothie bar, the cinema, the escalator… I was so happy to be there so I took my phone out to take photos of it. As I took photos, all the lights turned off except the neon bar. I suddenly became very aware someone was right behind me, following me. I turned to see a man of Asian descent, maybe 25-30, really close to me and I got this overwhelming feeling I needed to put my phone away. I spoke to him and said “haha you’re really close to me” and he laughed but kept following me, I could almost feel him breathing on my shoulders. I then took a sharp turn around a corner in the mall and he kept going the other way, I was relieved I’d lost him. I then pulled out my phone to check the photos and there they were. Then I woke up.
